procedural_matters: Ian Elliott (coach of SWE 216957) attended the hearing as an observer. Eros Gumus attended the hearing as interpreter for TUR 211921 .
facts: The protest form was submitted by SWE 216957 at 18:33.
The protest time limit is 90 minutes for Course Lima.
SWE 216957 was racing on course Lima.
The last race of the day was abandoned at 16:59.
SWE 216957 was looking for his coach, did not find him and found someone else to tow him.
SWE 216957 was towed ashore in the middle of the yellow fleet.
His coach was still on the water at that time.
After putting his boat away he tried to find someone to find his coach for 10 minutes.
It took SWE 216957 1 minute to fill out the protest form.
conclusions: SWE 216957 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1). There was no good reason for the PC to extend the time limit.
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
